confidence_notes: Holistic estimate, not checked against live listings. Persistent inflation, peso volatility and USD-quoted tourist pricing make Buenos Aires levels hard to pin down; hotels and drinks are least certain. Cocktail and wine_glass are derived from beer-relative ratios (about 2.2x and 1.25x beer), not direct price checks. FX is the RBA 4 pm figure for 14 Oct 2026 as reported in search results; the RBA page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Beer, coffee, meal and dorm anchors fall within the supplied Lima-Santiago range; the private hostel room and three-star hotel fall within the Santiago-Cartagena range; the basic hotel falls within Lima-Santiago. No other comparable basis used.
